page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration ensuring dedicated, non-shared CPU allocation.

This instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps to support data transfers.

Given the high resource density of 512.0 GB RAM paired with 64 dedicated cores, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. It is designed for enterprise applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics pipelines that benefit from high memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution.
